title: Two-dimensional linear-static cantilever
purpose: Exercise the model-first linear elasticity path, strong support, boundary traction, K/F system construction, PETSc solve, AF-IR export, and XDMF output.
physics: small-strain isotropic linear elasticity in plane strain

execution.evidence: The example must solve without validation errors, reproduce the versioned maximum-displacement Golden value, and write finite displacement results plus an AF-IR record.

observables: All displacement degrees of freedom are finite.
The fixed boundary remains at the prescribed displacement.
The displacement magnitude is nonzero under nonzero traction.
The result and AF-IR files are written by rank zero.
acceptance: The example exits successfully in the tested FEniCSx environment.
Model validation contains no errors before solve.
The output can be opened as an XDMF finite-element field.
The global maximum displacement satisfies the versioned absolute and relative tolerances.

quantities.name: maximum_displacement
quantities.description: Global maximum displacement magnitude for the fixed Q2 40-by-8 plane-strain release mesh and traction definition.

limitations: The Golden value is a numerical regression for a fixed discretization, not a mesh-convergence or analytical-error benchmark.
A future benchmark revision should also compare reaction equilibrium and a converged two-dimensional reference.
